robust_two_way_decomposition.carrier_update: median over months of response - grand - time_effect
robust_two_way_decomposition.time_update: median over carriers of response - grand - carrier_effect
robust_two_way_decomposition.identifiability: recenter carrier and time effects to zero median each iteration and absorb centers into grand

variance_diagnostics.method: standard balanced two-way ANOVA sums of squares on log cell-scale matrix for descriptive variance fractions; robust median-polish factors remain the normalization estimator

out_of_time_split.carrier_factor_stability: compare carrier relative log-scale factors estimated separately in train and evaluation months

leave_one_carrier_out.common_time_estimation: for each held-out carrier and evaluation month, estimate common-time effect from the other four carriers only
leave_one_carrier_out.heldout_carrier_factor: estimate from held-out carrier training months only
leave_one_carrier_out.evaluation: apply held-out carrier training factor plus other-carrier evaluation-month time factor to May-Sep held-out observations

state_conditional_description.state_definition: unchanged V1 T1=2 on raw slope_t
state_conditional_description.interpretation: descriptive only; not an independent regime decomposition because state is derived from the same score

clock_source_audit.eligible_comparison: same carrier with overlapping timestamps under an alternate source or alternate 60m clock
